patterns.note: Content is presented in wide, centered blocks with generous vertical spacing, creating an airy and uncluttered feel, especially in the hero section.
A very large, elegant serif typeface is used for primary headings, establishing a sophisticated and authoritative brand voice, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text.
The site uses a high-contrast palette of a very light, warm background and deep, almost black text, accented by a muted grey-brown for secondary elements and a vibrant orange for branding.
The main navigation header remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the hero content scrolls naturally underneath.
Image grids are used to showcase people and events, providing visual breaks and a sense of community within the content flow.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that remains fixed at the top of the screen, providing persistent access to main links. Content sections scroll vertically in a standard manner, with no complex scroll-triggered reveals or parallax effects observed.

Typography is a key design element, utilizing a large, elegant serif font for primary headings to convey gravitas and sophistication, complemented by a clean, highly readable sans-serif for all body and supporting text.

The color scheme leverages a light, off-white background with very dark text for optimal readability and a refined aesthetic. A distinct brand orange is used sparingly for key branding elements, while a warm, muted grey provides subtle contrast for secondary text and borders.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a refined, traditional feel, paired with a clear, modern sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly rectangular elements, sharp corners on buttons and input fields).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and content blocks, especially in the hero, creating a sense of calm and importance).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a very large, elegant serif typeface for its primary messaging, combined with a minimalist layout and a warm, muted color palette, creates an authoritative yet approachable feel that avoids typical tech-startup aesthetics. The focus on clear, direct communication over flashy visuals is notable.
